_note: Fallbacks used when a commodity record or the request lacks a value. Everything here is a prototype estimate unless a sourceId says otherwise.

storage._todo: Verify: assumes fresh produce is never frozen as-is (frozen vegetables are blanched first). Prototype rule, not source-backed.

messages.frozen: Frozen storage isn't supported for {name}: freezing ruptures the cells of fresh produce. Frozen vegetables are blanched first, which makes them a different product.

storage._todo: Dairy covers shelf-stable foods (milk powder) too, so every storage type stays allowed here; fresh dairy restricts itself with an allowedStorage param.

messages.ambient: {name} is a perishable fresh dairy food and isn't safe stored at ambient temperature. Choose chilled or frozen storage.

storage._todo: Verify: assumes raw meat and seafood are always kept cold (food-safety practice). Prototype rule, not source-backed.

messages.ambient: Raw meat and seafood such as {name} aren't safe stored at ambient temperature. Choose chilled or frozen storage.

respiration._note: O2 uptake at 20 °C by respiration class (mL O2/kg·h). Prototype estimates within published ranges.

oxygenBudgetMgPerKg._note: Tolerable O2 gain over shelf life (mg O2 per kg food), placed inside the ranges Robertson (2016) lists.

emap.label: Equilibrium MAP set by film permeance and micro-perforation

red_meat.label: High-O₂ MAP 70–80 % O₂ / 20–30 % CO₂, or vacuum skin

fish.label: 40 % CO₂ / 30 % O₂ / 30 % N₂ (white fish); 60 % CO₂ / 40 % N₂ (fatty fish)

mechanical._note: Required mechanical index (0-100) and maximum Gelbo flex pinholes (ASTM F392) by transport stress. Prototype estimates.

costs._note: Conversion overhead in INR per m² and EPR fee in INR per kg by category. Prototype estimates.
